'''X2-R Lookout Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These droids patrolled Hutt power generator tower in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
X2-R Lookout Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.
